summary: AGENTS.md and .claude/AGENTS.md take two absence gates: at launch any CLAUDE.md at the root or above shuts one; a subdirectory's shuts only on that subdirectory's own CLAUDE.md files
acceptance: a nested AGENTS.md under a root CLAUDE.md is reachable, one beside its own CLAUDE.md is not, and .claude/AGENTS.md is a launch-gated memory member; cargo test green
tests: a nested agents md under only a root claude md is loaded on demand
a nested agents md beside its own claude local md is shadowed
a dot claude agents md is a memory member shut by a root claude md
pins: an agents md beside a claude md with no import draws a not loaded reachability finding
notes: Docs re-read 2026-11-26 (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory, "AGENTS.md"): launch loads AGENTS.md and .claude/AGENTS.md at or above cwd only where no CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md sits at or above; a subdirectory's loads on Read when it has "none of the three CLAUDE.md files of its own". The setting override is PROJECT-INSTRUCTIONS-SETTING-OPENS-BOTH-AGENTS-MD-GATES.
